concept: Review and integration: the courage and discipline evidence-based thinking requires
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across following evidence against your group, spotting misinformation, and voicing an unpopular truth — which took the most courage?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real situation where this Pillar would apply to them

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
